markdown.error: Markdown could not be exported. Try the PPTX to Markdown Converter or a less complex presentation.

markdown.note: Markdown keeps text and basic structure, not slide layout. Slides remain in file order; hidden slides are included and marked. Speaker notes follow their slides. Images, charts, equations, media, and embedded objects use omission markers. Template decorations, review comments, animations, and transitions are not exported. Merged tables and complex formatting are simplified; check the output against the original.
